Q10281_MutatedKaneusRune/31335-02.htm.text: Magister Kayan: This is it. Tissue samples of the mutated Kaneus! Now we can move forward with our study about the mutated Kaneus and the nature of Kamaloka. Soon we will discover their underlying nature! This is only the beginning of a long journey to find the truth.

Q10281_MutatedKaneusRune/31335-01.htm.text: Magister Kayan: I heard about you from Captain Mathias. You'e the one who helped the Sages of Magic study the mutated Kaneus in Kamaloka, aren't you? I can now you now that our study is not limited simply to those mutants. Actually, Kamaloka itself is an omen of impending crisis and chaos. Others m…

Q10281_MutatedKaneusRune/31335-03.htm.text: Magister Kayan: Yes. The journey to reveal the truth about Kamaloka and Kaneus can now begin in earnest thanks to the tissue samples you provided. But there are still many Kamalokas to be investigated in this world. And it is vital that we gather information about every Kamaloka. You have already b…

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/31335-note.text: Magister Kayan: You're in the wrong place. I'm not who you seek. Maybe that person is somewhere in this library? Or perhaps the training camp across the street? Why don't you look around?

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/31335.html.text: Magister Kayan: This is a fascinating place, but it makes me feel uneasy. It's huge, filled with so many people and so different ideologies. I think I prefer to conduct my experiments alone.

You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!
